citations.assessment: The Midrash’s gazelle interpretation gives Yohanan ben Katzarta transmitting in Yonah’s name. Other place epithets in the fuller entry retain their differences.
The named figure is directly attested with bar in the Yerushalmi and ben in the Midrash. Keep Heilprin’s separate related lists and variants.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

citations.assessment: Midrash Shmuel names Yitzhak bar Katzarta. The fuller article gives an alternative spelling from the Yerushalmi and a tentative scribal-error proposal. Preserve the three names in this roster.
